## What changed

**`apps/web/src/session/useRoomProjection.ts`**
- Added `UseRoomProjectionOptions` (`presentEvents?`, `storage?`) and the new `PresentationItem` type. Removed `recoveredResult`; added `presentation` and `acknowledgePresentation`.
- One `PresentationSession` per effect instance (created on the first tail sync). Baseline logic: `store.load()`; if `null`, `readEventTailHead` and `emptyLedgerData(head)`, except when this sync pass's `reconcilePending` returned accepted results with `acceptedSequence`, then `baseline[p] = max(0, min(head[p], lowestAccepted - 1))`.
- Each `sync()` runs projection refresh → reconcile → tail sync (≤4 pages from `session.fetchCursor()`), in its own try/catch so a tail failure never touches `status`/`lastError`/projection. Rejected results still call `setLastError`; accepted results just refresh the projection and rely on the tail.
- `presentation` is derived in `useMemo` gating on `projection.roomRevision`; cleanup drops the session and the `cancelled` guard protects late async results.
- Note: `attackSuccessesRolled` is attached when publishing (`decorate(...)`, inside the effect/event handler) rather than inside the `useMemo`. The repo's new `react-hooks/refs` rule forbids reading `sessionRef.current` during render; the observable behavior is identical and the revision gate is still the derived `useMemo` rule.

**`apps/web/src/session/presentationQueue.ts`** (new) — pure `selectOwnResolution` / `isOwnResolutionItem`.

**`apps/web/src/player2/PlayerDashboardScreen.tsx`** — uses `{ presentEvents: true }`, drops `findRecoveredActionResolution`/`pendingResolution`/`dismissedRecovery` and the `dispatch(...).sharedEvents` summary building, derives `resolution` from `selectOwnResolution`, acknowledges every `resolution.eventIds` on continue, and auto-acknowledges non-own-resolution items in a `presentation`-keyed effect.

**Tests** — new `presentationQueue.test.ts` (6 cases), new `useRoomProjection.presentation.test.tsx` (a–g), and rewritten `recoveredResolution.test.ts`.
